description: Reads the verification code (OTP/2FA) from an email in your inbox; optional message_id selects a message. list_email_messages inspects messages. Takes inbox_id, capability and access_token from create_email_inbox. No extra charge. Polling interval: at least 2s; 429 or 503 means wait. Pending/no_code/ambiguous is not a usable code; external acceptance is not guaranteed.

access_token.description: Use the scoped access_token returned by create_email_inbox. Optional only for an existing provisioned private pilot connection.

name: get_email_code

outputSchema.description: Fields only; full schema in GET /v1/catalog.
